theorems.name: Submission.gte_lipschitz_ball_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (K : ℝ≥0) (R : ℝ), LipschitzOnWith K f (closedBall 0 R) → MeasurableSet (ball (0 : Rn n) R ∩ {x | ¬DifferentiableAt ℝ f x}) ∧ volume (ball (0 : Rn n) R ∩ {x | ¬DifferentiableAt ℝ f x}) = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ K ∧ (DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → ∀ (j : Fin ℓ) (v : Rn n), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) x) v = fderiv ℝ f x v j)
